_comment: Career dossiers for careers.html. Each entry is a real occupation an agent is learning to hold; benchmarks are the evidence. Every slug in data/benchmarks/ must appear exactly once across careers (tools/build.py enforces this). status: 'certifying' = first roles TokenWave certifies, 'next' = on the roadmap.

careers.name: Forward-Deployed Engineer
careers.tagline: The engineer who makes AI work inside someone else's stack
careers.description: A forward-deployed engineer is judged on one thing: whether the system runs in the customer's environment, not the vendor's demo. The work is unglamorous and unforgiving — standing up infrastructure, wiring tools and permissions together, carrying a workflow across terminal, browser, and GUI until it verifiably finishes. An agent that holds this job must sustain execution over long horizons and recover when the environment pushes back.
careers.duties: Environment bring-up · Incident response · Long-horizon tool & GUI workflows

careers.name: Software Engineer
careers.tagline: Ships the feature, reviews the diff, keeps the repository alive
careers.description: Software is where agent claims meet the cleanest acceptance test: the code either works or it does not. This dossier spans the full delivery loop — implementing features against a living repository, generating and completing code across languages and stacks, building interactive front ends, and the review-side craft of tracing executions and localizing faults. The gap between an agent you supervise and one you trust lives here.
careers.duties: Feature implementation · Code review & testing · Repository maintenance

careers.name: Evaluation & Data Specialist
careers.tagline: Judges model output for a living — including other agents'
careers.description: Our own profession, held to its own standard. An evaluation specialist reads long-form output and scores it consistently, finds the error buried two hundred steps into a reasoning chain, critiques formal work without rubber-stamping it, and refuses the shortcuts that quietly inflate scores. The reasoning and structured-data probes in this dossier are the same ones an eval team runs before anything ships to a customer.
careers.duties: Benchmark construction · Reward & critic modeling · Regression review

careers.name: Research Analyst
careers.tagline: Delivers the defensible answer, with sources attached
careers.description: The analyst's deliverable is a conclusion someone will act on — which means every claim has to survive scrutiny. This dossier measures the full arc of the job: multi-hop research across the open web, literature-grade reasoning, evidence-backed report writing, and the factual recall that anchors all of it. Fluent prose is easy; an audit trail is the profession.
careers.duties: Deep research · Competitive & academic analysis · Long-form reporting

careers.name: Content & Media Operator
careers.tagline: Watches everything, misses nothing, describes it to spec
careers.description: Media operations run on dense, sustained perception: hour-long footage that must be understood at multiple time scales, images whose meaning is implied rather than stated, captions written to a brief, and generated audio-video that has to be quality-checked before it ships. This dossier covers the multimodal competence the role consumes daily, from archive tagging to creative review.
careers.duties: Content tagging & captioning · Archive search · Generated-media QA

careers.name: Customer Engagement Specialist
careers.tagline: Carries the brand through a thousand conversations
careers.description: A customer-facing role is a liability the moment it drifts — out of policy, out of character, or into a confident wrong answer on a sensitive topic. This dossier tests what the job actually demands: safety that holds under sustained multi-turn pressure, factual reliability where it is non-negotiable, and a persona that stays coherent across a long interaction instead of dissolving into a generic assistant.
careers.duties: Customer engagement · Policy compliance · Persona-driven service
